    StartersEnrique's bean and cheese quesadillasCrisp tortillas with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, salsa and sour creamHow to make it4 large flour tortillas400g refried beans200g cheddar, grated1 jar pickled jalapenos, sliced200g tomato salsa150g sour creamSpread each tortilla with refried beans over half, scatter with cheddar and jalapenos and fold over.Toast in a dry pan over medium heat, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts, turning once.Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa and sour cream.Border run chicken empanadasBaked pastry turnovers filled with smoky chicken, egg and olivesHow to make it400g chicken thigh mince1 onion, diced1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp sweet paprika3 eggs50g pitted green olives, chopped3 sheets of shortcrust pastryBoil two of the eggs until hard, then cool, peel and chop.Fry the chicken mince and onion with the cumin and paprika until browned.Stir in the chopped eggs and olives and cool the filling.Cut the pastry into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp the edges.Brush with the remaining beaten egg. Bake at 200°C until golden.Elote with cotija and chilliGrilled corn cobs with lime mayo, crumbled cotija and chilli powderHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsDesert camp tacosLime and cumin marinated skirt steak in corn tortillas with dried chilli salsaHow to make it800g skirt steak2 limes4 garlic cloves1 tsp ground cumin3 dried chillies1 tomato16 corn tortillas1 onion, finely diced1 bunch corianderMarinate the steak in lime juice, three of the garlic cloves and the cumin in the fridge.Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with the tomato and remaining garlic for a salsa roja.Grill the steak on high heat, then rest and slice against the grain.Warm the tortillas and serve with the steak, salsa, onion and coriander.Galleria food court double smash burgerTwo thin smashed patties, American cheese, pickles, lettuce and tangy sauceHow to make it800g beef mince8 slices of American cheese4 burger buns4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp tomato relish1 tsp American mustard1 iceberg lettuce, shredded1 jar dill pickles, slicedRoll the mince into 8 balls and season well with salt and pepper.Mix the mayonnaise, relish and mustard for the sauce.Heat a griddle or heavy pan until smoking, add the balls and smash flat with a spatula.Cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip and top each patty with a slice of cheese for 1 minute.Toast the buns, then stack two patties on each with sauce, lettuce and pickles. Wrap in baking paper for 2 minutes.SweetsEnrique's camp churrosFried churros rolled in cinnamon sugar with a hot chocolate dipHow to make it250ml water30g butterpinch of salt150g plain flour1 egg2 L vegetable oil80g caster sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon150ml thickened cream150g dark chocolate, choppedBoil the water, butter and salt, then beat in the flour until it forms a ball. Cool, then beat in the egg.Heat the oil to 180°C and pipe 12cm lengths with a star nozzle, fry until golden.Roll in the sugar mixed with the cinnamon.Heat the cream and stir in the chocolate until smooth for dipping.DrinksLiquid nitrogen frozen margaritaTequila, lime and orange liqueur blended slushy with ice, salted rimHow to make it5 limes180ml tequila60ml orange liqueur40ml sugar syrup4 cups ice1 tbsp salt flakes, for the rimsRub the glass rims with lime and dip in salt.Blend the tequila, the juice of the remaining limes, orange liqueur, sugar syrup and ice until smooth and slushy.Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels. Serve immediately.Ice cold Mexican lager with limeIce cold Mexican lager with a wedge of lime in the neckHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
